sentences.en: The girl closed her eyes and listened to the pastor.
sentences.zh: 那个女孩闭上眼睛，倾听牧师的话语。

sentences.en: Sami went to the church and met with the pastor.
sentences.zh: 萨米去了教堂，并且见到了牧师。

sentences.en: Sami was described as a beloved pastor by his congregation.
sentences.zh: 他的教众形容萨米是一位深受爱戴的牧师。
